name: Title Case the selection
description: Copies the selected text in the frontmost app, converts it to Title Case (small words such as "of" and "the" stay lowercase) and pastes it over the selection. The original selection is left on the clipboard.
request: Make ⌃⌥⌘T convert the text I have selected in any app to Title Case, replacing the selection.

inputs.selection: the lord of the rings: the return of the king

tests.expect: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

inputs.selection: THE QUICK BROWN FOX JUMPS OVER THE LAZY DOG

tests.expect: The Quick Brown Fox Jumps Over the Lazy Dog

inputs.selection: self-driving cars in the city: state-of-the-art or out-of-date

tests.expect: Self-Driving Cars in the City: State-of-the-Art or Out-of-Date
